Usage: astryx doctor integration [options] [command]

Check an integration package while authoring it

Options:
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  validate [package]    Validate an integration manifest and its contributions
  templates [package]   Validate integration template replacements and Core id overlaps
  components [package]  Check integration component names, replacements, and documented props
  docs [package]        Check an integration's docs: the docs tree they add, every link, and overlaps with Core topics

Exit codes:
  0  help is shown or the selected check has no errors
  1  the selected check reports an error

Examples:
  # Validate a local integration
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration validate
  # Check template ids against Core
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration templates
  # Check component names against Core
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration components
  # Classify doc overlaps with Core
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration docs

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/doctor-integration
